explication: SONiC SWSS is the switch-state service: it connects network-control and configuration inputs to switch state and hardware through database-backed daemons. The principal path is route information from FPM/BGP into route tables, then orchestration into SAI. Other branches synchronize link, neighbor, FDB, and team state, manage switch features, and collect/report counters. The README describes SWSS’s database-interface role; edges for unsampled daemons are limited to that documented role and their tree-supported responsibilities.
